title: Repair Estimates & Appointments Desk Authority: Amount of Storage Goodwill
content:
**Clause.** On a Repair Estimates & Appointments booking, the storage goodwill is the goodwill figure, rounded to the cent once at the end, but never more than the goodwill authority left on the booking nor more than the storage charge's outstanding amount; the goodwill figure is the goodwill percentage of the storage statement charge. The standard goodwill percentage is **2%** (0.02) of the storage statement charge, the goodwill authority is the estimate type's desk goodwill authority, and the goodwill authority left is that authority less every goodwill waiver already booked on the booking; where those waivers already reach the authority, no authority is left.

**Terms used in the clause**

- *Storage statement charge* — the storage charge on the booking that the goodwill relieves, identified by its charge reference number.
- *Outstanding amount of the storage charge* — its amount less every waiver and every payment already recorded against that charge.
- *Goodwill already booked on the booking* — every waiver with the reason goodwill recorded on the booking, against any of its charges.

**Assembly.** The storage goodwill is the lowest of three figures — the goodwill figure, the goodwill authority left and the storage charge's outstanding amount — rounded to the cent once, at the end.

**Worked figures** (hypothetical bookings; an authority of 95.00 USD is used for illustration)

| Storage statement charge | Goodwill figure (2%) | Goodwill already booked | Authority left | Outstanding on the charge | Storage goodwill |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 600.00 USD | 12.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 95.00 USD | 600.00 USD | 12.00 USD |
| 588.35 USD | 11.767 USD | 0.00 USD | 95.00 USD | 588.35 USD | 11.77 USD |
| 600.00 USD | 12.00 USD | 90.00 USD | 5.00 USD | 600.00 USD | 5.00 USD |
| 600.00 USD | 12.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 95.00 USD | 8.00 USD (592.00 USD paid) | 8.00 USD |
| 600.00 USD | 12.00 USD | 100.00 USD | none | 600.00 USD | 0.00 USD |
